## Summary

**Replace ambiguous UNKNOWN and generic No data**

The screenshots use UNKNOWN, No data, VALID_EMPTY, N/A and zero for multiple incompatible meanings.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-01`
- DUX code: `DUX5-01`

## Scope

All dashboards; every status and empty-state panel.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07 (all boards)

## Concrete change

Introduce the canonical health/execution/evidence/applicability vocabularies. Require a reason and evidence state whenever the primary state is not self-explanatory.

## Expected effect

Operators can distinguish missing telemetry, not-started work, valid empty results and backend failures without opening panel details.

## Acceptance criteria

- No primary status card displays bare UNKNOWN or No data. Screenshot tests cover every state class.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Bounded status/reason codes from APIs or recording rules; copy mapping in interface layer.

## Risk

Incorrect mapping could hide a real incident; requires semantics review.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Extends DUX4-12/13/14 + verdict-ontology into operator-visible state classes (missing/stale/not-started/valid-empty/backend-error).

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
